detailed_descriptions.en: Hacker’s Journey is a story-driven hacking simulator built on a simple promise: every scenario in this game was designed by cybersecurity experts who do this work for real. No Hollywood hacking. The vulnerabilities you exploit are the vulnerabilities researchers find in production systems. The mistakes the targets make are the mistakes companies make all the time. Follow a complete story from your first compromised box to the final mission. Each mission advances the plot and introduces new techniques. FEATURES A linear story campaign written by professional cybersecurity researchers Hybrid terminal + desktop interface modeled on real attacker workflows Web application exploitation: SQL injection, IDOR, authentication bypass Network and infrastructure attacks: reconnaissance, lateral movement, privilege escalation, Ransomware attacks Real hacker techniques: Supply-chain attacks, credit card skimming, crypto money laundering

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Hacker’s Journey is a story-driven hacking simulator built on a simple promise: every scenario in this game was designed by cybersecurity experts who do this work for real. No Hollywood hacking. The vulnerabilities you exploit are the vulnerabilities researchers find in production systems. The mistakes the targets make are the mistakes companies make all the time.

Follow a complete story from your first compromised box to the final mission. Each mission advances the plot and introduces new techniques.

FEATURES

  • A linear story campaign written by professional cybersecurity researchers

  • Hybrid terminal + desktop interface modeled on real attacker workflows

  • Web application exploitation: SQL injection, IDOR, authentication bypass

  • Network and infrastructure attacks: reconnaissance, lateral movement, privilege escalation, Ransomware attacks

  • Real hacker techniques: Supply-chain attacks, credit card skimming, crypto money laundering
